list.title: Billing
list.emptyBody: Bill a finished work order from its page, or create a manual document here. Closed rentals are billed automatically.

lines.title: Lines
lines.invalid: Fill in the description, quantity and unit amount.
lines.discountHint: Subtracted from the subtotal. It cannot be more than the subtotal.

create.title: New billing document
create.manualBody: Choose the customer and add the lines. The document starts as a draft you can still edit.
create.sourceBody: The lines come from the source. Review them; the document starts as a draft you can still edit.
create.customerHint: The source has no customer. Choose who receives this document.

issue.title: Issue billing document
issue.body: After issuing, the lines can no longer be edited. You can still cancel it.
issue.nfeHint: Optional. Reference to an NF-e issued in your fiscal system.
issue.nfeKeyInvalid: The access key has 44 digits. Check it and try again.

cancel.title: Cancel billing document
cancel.body: The document stays in the history marked as cancelled. This cannot be undone.

panel.title: Billing
panel.noneBody: No billing document yet for this record.
panel.existsBody: This record already has a billing document.
